changes: lib reorg: third-party clients moved to lib/integrations/<service>/index.ts (recurly, partner-billing, ums-reporting); cross-cutting libs moved to lib/utils/<area>/index.ts (logger, errors, events-publisher, report-builder, params); lib/adobe-commerce/catalog kept.
Every lib module is now folder-per-module <module>/index.ts (was bare publisher.ts/builder.ts/params.ts).
ABDB collection/repository dirs renamed to kebab-case (sling-prerenewal-notifications); collection name string kept snake_case; classes PascalCase.
Exported domain interfaces split into sibling types.ts (report-builder/types.ts, NavigationProvider/types.ts); Logger interface left inline in utils/logger.
APP_SLUG and APP_NAME centralized into actions/constants.ts (imported by the registration action).
Removed the starter-kit sample lib/database/collection/user + repository/user and their tests (generator had left them).
Added a co-located test/** stub per lib module and restored jest coverage gate to 100%.
